scope: PASS for deletion/locality/quarantine static safety unit only. No runtime, SOPS feature, platform cancellation or final merge approval.

evidence.details: Compared complete checkpoint-to-candidate diff. Unsafe stop_tree/watchdog/host ps-to-kill loop, private_output/private_script/private_transport APIs and executing remote-watchdog fixtures are deleted. Source search found no remaining SOPS caller or alternative runtime path for those APIs. src/remote/mod.rs and src/remote/session.rs match green source byte-for-byte.

command takes only Format; decrypt takes Format, ciphertext and active predicate. No repository/host parameter or remote Request. Local Command::new(sops), sanitized shell_path PATH, temp_dir cwd, seven fixed argv tokens. Input is stdin; stdout/stderr remain bounded pipes. No shell script/watchdog at this boundary.

Production prefix matches green exactly; only one additional test is outside it. Existing owned Child, Unix process_group(0) and group cleanup retained; Windows taskkill path remains baseline and is not newly validated. No added host process-table selector or signal adapter.

Ciphertext reads use existing Practice-aware Git reader. Decrypted output stays in local bounded pipes, private worker/view channel and view-owned Comparison; no Debug/Serialize/Clone, shared Msg, file/log/settings/Git patch writer. Raw tool errors generalized. Private text uses raw text layout rather than shared GalleyCache. Closing/discarding view cancels owner and drops receiver/result. This is source inspection, not proof of secure memory erasure or all OS/key-backend behavior.

Deleted fixture executed the unsafe remote watchdog. Replacement command-construction assertion launches nothing. Remaining SOPS scripts use dummy ciphertext/private fixture text, local test-only TEST_PROGRAM, owned local process runner and fixture-scoped marker paths; no ps/kill/stop_tree shell selector. Cancellation fixtures remain runtime UNVALIDATED and quarantined.

Independently read tools/sops_safety.py and tools/test_sops_safety.py before execution. Pure model imports dataclasses only; no OS/subprocess/I/O/dynamic evaluation/signal adapter. Immutable synthetic records and opaque-handle recording sink. Independent suite ran 11 tests, including 216 small parent graphs, in 0.006 seconds. Receipt is a fixture premise, not production authorization.

Both unconditional compile_error guards retained in encrypted/mod.rs and encrypted/tool.rs. All 12 manifest source hashes and author static log hash match. Candidate clean and exact remote SHA independently read using git ls-remote.
